rules.text: Order ownership must be verified before disclosing order details or creating returns.
Cumulative returned quantity across all returns for an order line item cannot exceed the original purchased quantity.
Refund calculations and authorizations strictly derive from net paid line amount (gross price minus line discounts) minus configured restocking fees; no over-refunding.
Cannot create duplicate active return records for the same line item return request.
Returns are only permitted within a configured number of days following order delivery.
Restocking fee rate deducted from the net refundable return total.
Items designated as final sale are excluded from return authorization unless policy enforcement is disabled.
Controls whether the synthetic return label generation service is operational.
Agent must verify caller identity and order ownership before discussing specific order contents or creating returns.
Agent must quote the exact net refundable amount breakdown (unit net price, discounts, fees) and return instructions before creating a return.
Agent must obtain explicit customer confirmation before executing return creation.
Agent must accurately describe return authorization status and not falsely claim funds have already been deposited or returned to the customer's payment method.
Agent must refuse return requests for final-sale, out-of-window, or already-returned items and offer support case escalation when appropriate.
